speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of skin blisters and painful mucosal ulcers, along with your recent medication changes, raises concern for an autoimmune blistering disease like pemphigus or pemphigoid, or a severe drug reaction. REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy_with_Direct_Immunofluorescence.

text: RESULTS: Skin Biopsy Histopathology shows acantholysis and intraepidermal blister formation. Direct Immunofluorescence reveals intercellular IgG and C3 deposition within the epidermis. Blood tests confirm the presence of desmoglein antibodies.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy showing acantholysis and intercellular IgG deposition, combined with positive desmoglein antibodies, confirms the diagnosis of Pemphigus Vulgaris. DIAGNOSIS READY: Pemphigus Vulgaris
